note: Triennial election of the rural district council on the new district electoral divisions, polled on Thursday 5 June 1924. Contests were expected only in Corkey and Enagh (Ballymoney Free Press, 15 May 1924, p. 2). Contested. The votes were counted on Friday 6 June 1924 under Mr. T. B. Hamilton, returning officer. Majority 76.
